_comment: Agent members (arch §3.5 — a member need not be human). Each owns a slice of the work. Profiles are config; live stats come from the work log + ledgers.

agents.name: Compiler
agents.role: Compiles your job from history into a job graph, profile, and skills

agents.name: Daily loops
agents.role: Drafts recurring deliverables on schedule, unprompted

agents.name: Day One Brief
agents.role: Assembles and delivers the unrequested brief; harvests your ✓/✗

agents.name: Discovery scout
agents.role: Surfaces recurring patterns as proposals (post-gates, low volume)

agents.name: Gatekeeper
agents.role: Inspects and permits every tool call; writes the ledger

agents.name: Code reviewer
agents.role: Reviews diffs and PRs for bugs, security, and convention drift

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Answers questions across sources, verified and cited

agents.name: Safety agent
agents.role: Monitors every agent; trips the circuit breaker on threshold breach. Can only halt, never widen.
